_readme: Coordinate corrections. Some Notion places carry a stale placeholder coord (39.9042,116.4074 is
the Beijing default and appears on anything never geocoded) or a hand-placed one that is simply
wrong. rebuild.mjs prefers this file over the snapshot, so a bad coord cannot silently invent or
delete travel time. Notion is NOT modified — fix it there separately if you ever want to.
Each entry records what was wrong and where the right value came from.

Glacier Park cable car.why: Was sitting in Lijiang old town, ~30 km south of the mountain it climbs. The chain therefore drove you to the old town, then charged a phantom 54-min / 31 km DiDi from there up to the Jade Dragon summit — when in reality the cableway IS the ascent and the two are one continuous stop.
Glacier Park cable car.source: Co-located with 'Jade Dragon summit'. Not a surveyed base-station fix: for travel-time purposes the drive is to the scenic area and the ascent is the cable car, so treating them as one location is what the chain actually needs. Confidence: the old-town value was definitely wrong; this value is right to within the scenic area.

Toboggan down.why: Was the central-Beijing placeholder, 60 km from the wall. The toboggan IS the descent from Mutianyu — you board it at the top of the wall you just walked. The bad coord made the chain charge a 97-min, 60 km DiDi between the wall and the luge, then charge nothing for the real drive back to the city.
Toboggan down.source: Same coord as Mutianyu Great Wall (the launch platform is beside tower 6).
